title: System Programming Essentials with Go
title_original: System Programming Essentials with Go: System calls, networking, efficiency, and security practices with practical projects in Golang
author: Alex Rios
summary: Linux-mərkəzli sistem proqramlaşdırma dövrü: syscall mexanizmi (syscall/x/sys/os qatları, strace, stdio/fayl deskriptorları), fayl idarəsi (permission/umask, filepath, symlink, dublikat-hash), sistem hadisələri (siqnallar, fsnotify/inotify, fayl rotasiyası, exec timeout, distributed lock), IPC (anonim + named pipe/mkfifo, log aləti), Unix domain socketlər (chat server, HTTP-over-UDS, lsof), yaddaş (tri-color GC, GOGC/GOMEMLIMIT/ballast/arena), performans (escape analysis -m, benchmark, CPU/memory pprof), şəbəkə (TCP/UDP+SACK, HTTP+TLS/openssl, WebSocket), telemetriya (slog/zap, runtime/trace, distributed tracing, Prometheus 4 metric tipi, OTel), paylama (modules/SemVer/MVS, GOPRIVATE, go.work, CI cache+Staticcheck, GoReleaser), capstone paylanmış keş (RWMutex, TTL+LRU container/list, P2P replikasiya X-Replication-Request, consistent hashing hash ring), effektiv praktikalar (sync.Pool, OnceValue, singleflight, mmap, 6 leak tələsi), real dünya (Dropbox/HashiCorp/Docker/SoundCloud) + hardware avtomatlaşdırma (D-Bus UDisks2, /proc/mounts, Bluetooth RSSI lock).
